title:
Q. 소개팅에서
「나 마음에 들었구나」 티 나는 순간?

clips.sub:
음... 질문이 계속 나올 때요?
그거 티 나요.
clips.prompt: Candid documentary-style street interview, vertical, slight natural handheld shake. Location: Han River park in Seoul on a clear autumn afternoon, grass, trees and the river softly blurred behind; absolutely no signs, no letters, no text anywhere in the background. An interviewer's hand holds a small black microphone into the frame from the right. A naturally beautiful Korean woman in her late 20s, minimal makeup, long hair moving in the wind, oversized beige cardigan, thinks for a second, laughs naturally and answers in casual Korean: "음... 질문이 계속 나올 때요? 그거 티 나요." Real-person feel, not posed, natural skin texture.

Candid documentary-style street interview, vertical, slight natural handheld shake. Location: a quiet tree-lined residential street in Seoul with ginkgo trees turning yellow, brick walls, soft afternoon light; absolutely no signs, no letters, no text anywhere in the background. An interviewer's hand holds a small black microphone into the frame from the left. A handsome Korean man around 30, natural look, short hair, grey sweatshirt under a black coat, smiles a bit shyly and answers in casual Korean: "끝나고 역까지 데려다준다고 할 때요." Real-person feel, not posed, natural skin texture.

clips.sub:
폰을 아예 안 봐요.
그게 제일 커요.
clips.prompt: Candid documentary-style street interview, vertical, slight natural handheld shake. Location: a quiet park path in Seoul lined with autumn trees, fallen leaves, soft afternoon light; absolutely no signs, no letters, no text anywhere in the background. An interviewer's hand holds a small black microphone into the frame from the left. A naturally beautiful Korean woman around 30, minimal makeup, short bob hair, cream scarf and navy coat, nods and answers casually and answers in casual Korean: "폰을 아예 안 봐요. 그게 제일 커요." Real-person feel, not posed, natural skin texture.

clips.sub:
다음에 언제 시간 되냐고
먼저 물어볼 때요.
clips.prompt: Candid documentary-style street interview, vertical, slight natural handheld shake. Location: Han River park in Seoul on a clear autumn afternoon, grass, trees and the river softly blurred behind, a bridge far in the distance; absolutely no signs, no letters, no text anywhere in the background. An interviewer's hand holds a small black microphone into the frame from the right. A handsome Korean man in his early 30s, natural look, neat hair, beige trench coat, laughs naturally and answers in casual Korean: "다음에 언제 시간 되냐고 먼저 물어볼 때요." Real-person feel, not posed, natural skin texture.
